dialogues.jp:
まあ、こんなもんだろう。目覚ましのセットだ
けはどんな形でも一緒か。
dialogues.en:
This should be fine. I've set it to be pretty much the same
as my old one.
dialogues.text:
This should be fine. I've set it to be pretty much the same
as my old one.

dialogues.jp: 今日はどんな夢を見させられるんだか……。
dialogues.en: What kind of dream will I see tonight...
dialogues.text: What kind of dream will I see tonight...

dialogues.jp: できれば見たくないが。
dialogues.en: I thought, as I closed my eyes.
dialogues.text: I thought, as I closed my eyes.

dialogues.jp:
目覚ましってやつは、どれもこれも似たり寄っ
たりだなぁ……と思いつつ寝た。
dialogues.en:
This new alarm clock is very much the same as my old one...
and I fell asleep after that thought.
dialogues.text:
This new alarm clock is very much the same as my old one...
and I fell asleep after that thought.
